$comment: The test waters' words. `mechanisms`: for every mechanism of the ladder, what a case of it shows (shipped as guide.cases.mechanisms and each case's `shows`); its ORDER is the order of guide.cases. `what_to_show`: one plain line for the page builder ({water} and {fish} are filled from the case; {steelhead_no_rules} is guide_words.STEELHEAD_NO_RULES). Read by pipeline/deliver/export/cases.py.

mechanisms.zone_only: a water with no row of its own: the region's table speaks alone
mechanisms.quota_beside: a water quota that says something DIFFERENT from the zone's sits beside it — both speak (`ladder.quotas_sit_beside`, case 3)
mechanisms.larger_replaces: a water row printing a LARGER number for a fish lifts the zone's quota for that fish, and speaks alone (case 2)
mechanisms.same_statement: a water quota stating EXACTLY the zone's statement replaces the zone's number, here a larger one (case 1)
mechanisms.water_release: a water's outright release silences a zone quota of another dimension for that fish (`ladder.water_release`)
mechanisms.naming_beats_group: a zone rule NAMING the fish beats a water row's GROUP rule for it
mechanisms.water_names_fish: a water row that itself names the fish beats the zone's rule naming it
mechanisms.within_clause_parent_level: a zone quota's `within` clause naming the fish is read at its parent's (group) level: the water's group release beats it
mechanisms.water_closure_silences_zone: a water's dated closure speaks for every fish it covers as if it named it: the zone's named quota is silent on its dates
mechanisms.derived_lift: a water row naming a fish its region closes lifts that closure (`exempts[].basis: names_the_fish`)
mechanisms.printed_lift_reopens_closure: a printed lift of a region's species closure reopens it
mechanisms.closure_prints_its_exemptions: a region's closure that prints its own exemption list takes no derived lift: a water row naming the fish leaves it standing
mechanisms.blanket_closure_exempt: a blanket seasonal closure lifted on a water exempt from it
mechanisms.equivalent_lift: a row's lift of its region's blanket closure reaches the SAME KIND of closure in another region its water lies in (`exempts[].equivalent`)
mechanisms.lift_for_one_fish: a lift for one fish leaves the lifted rule standing for every other fish (asked about a fish the lift does not name)
mechanisms.partly_lifted: a lift that holds only for some anglers or fish leaves the rule standing, marked `partly_lifted`
mechanisms.counted_apart: a fish counted apart from the zone's aggregate by the zone's own table (`ladder.counted_apart`)
mechanisms.two_regions_lake: a lake drawn across a region line: both regions' tables bind, the MOST STRICT displaces the other (`ladder.two_regions`)
mechanisms.home_region_differs: a river piece taking the zone rules of the region it lies in, which is not the region of its own row
mechanisms.pointer: a pointer row ('See X') binds nothing; the target row's rules speak on the pointer's water
mechanisms.steelhead_water: where a rainbow over 50 cm is a steelhead, a rule about rainbow over 50 cm speaks for no rainbow
mechanisms.dated_in_force: a dated water rule on a day it is in force
mechanisms.dated_out_of_force: the same water and fish on a day the dated rule is not in force
mechanisms.semicolon_dated_clause: a date printed after a semicolon clause scopes only that clause: the clause before it holds all year
mechanisms.part_day_decides: a rule in force only some hours or weekdays DECIDES at the moments it covers (`at`: inside its hours, on its weekdays) and is out at the others
mechanisms.suspended_while: a record dormant while its named closure is in force (`suspended_while`: today only licensing records carry it) — asked on a day the closure speaks
mechanisms.size_band: a quota with a size window (`lengths`)
mechanisms.origin: a rule about hatchery or wild fish only (`origin`)
mechanisms.while_or_targeting: a rule that holds only while fishing a way (`while`) or for a target (`when_targeting`)
mechanisms.gear_only: a water whose own row says only how to fish (gear, bait, method)
mechanisms.annual_clock: a quota on another clock than the day (`period`)
mechanisms.superior_authority: a federal or park rule, outside the ladder
mechanisms.standing: a standing rule: shown everywhere, never deciding
mechanisms.angler_closure: a water closed to one kind of angler (`closed_to`)
mechanisms.tributary_walk: a water rule reaching this water by the tributary walk (`via: trib`)
mechanisms.watershed_part: a rule bound to a PART of a watershed, cut by FWA code (`Extent.watershed`)
mechanisms.undrawn_part: a rule held on the water as a note, in a part nothing draws (`undrawn_part`)
mechanisms.licensing_stamp: a water where a stamp is required
mechanisms.province_except: a part where a province-wide licensing requirement stops (a national park)
mechanisms.outside_bc: a part of a water outside British Columbia: no rules at all
mechanisms.clause_only_lift: a water number larger than one CLAUSE of the zone's quota lifts only that clause: the fish still counts toward the zone's aggregate (Duncan-style)
mechanisms.dated_lift: a lift in force only while its lifter is: on a day the lifter's dates exclude, the lifted zone rule speaks again (Williston-style)
mechanisms.same_statement_smaller: a water quota stating EXACTLY the zone's statement with a SMALLER number replaces the zone's number (case 1)
mechanisms.streams_only_zone_clause: a zone clause that binds only on streams ('2 from streams'), speaking on a stream
mechanisms.two_regions_closure: a lake across a region line: one region's CLOSURE of a fish displaces the other region's open rule for it
mechanisms.two_regions_release: a lake across a region line: one region's RELEASE of a fish displaces the other region's quota for it
mechanisms.keep_beside_release: a clause that KEEPS some of a fish speaking beside a release of others of the same fish (hatchery kept, wild released)
mechanisms.undrawn_closure: a closure in a part nobody has drawn, held on the whole water as a note (`not_yet_mapped`): it silences nothing
mechanisms.size_clause_caution: a larger water number printed '(any size)' lifts the zone's size clause ('1 over 50 cm') too, and only such a lift carries `caution` (size_clause_override)
mechanisms.kootenay_rainbow_10: Kootenay Lake (main body): rainbow 10 (any size) replaces Region 4's trout/char 5 and its size clause for rainbow
mechanisms.dean_beside: the Dean River: its 'Trout/char daily quota = 1 (none under 35 cm)' sits beside Region 5's 'Trout/char: 5'
mechanisms.straddling_named_lake: Ahbau Lake (Region 5 / Zone 7A) or Mara Lake (Region 3 / Region 8): both regions' tables bind the lake
mechanisms.trout_word_same_statement: Amor Lake: its 'Trout daily quota = 2' (no char mentioned: trout and char) and Region 1's 'Trout: 4' (its box mentions char: trout only) are the same statement — the lake's 2 replaces the 4 for a trout (`gotchas.trout_includes_char`)
mechanisms.dated_zone_release_stands: Shuswap Lake on Nov 1: Region 3's dated lake trout release speaks beside the lake's 'Char daily quota = 1' (`ladder.dated_zone_release`)
mechanisms.water_dates_override: Cheslatta Lake on Nov 15: the lake's own-dated 'Lake trout … quotas = 3' (Nov 1-Sept 14) replaces Region 6's 'Lake trout … Sept 15-Nov 30' release on the days both hold (`ladder.dated_zone_release` (A))
mechanisms.one_side_beside: Kitimat River at the hatchery outfall: the west-half closure is shown BESIDE the river's other rules, which the east half answers to (`fields.side`)
mechanisms.steelhead_known: a KNOWN steelhead stream (`steelhead: known`) of the book: a steelhead row's rules bind it (`steelhead_source` "regulations") — the provincial steelhead set and the region's steelhead lines apply, and a rainbow over 50 cm is a steelhead (`anadromous_rainbow`)
mechanisms.steelhead_possible: a POSSIBLE steelhead stream (`steelhead: possible`): a stream of Regions 1, 2, 3, 5 or 6 the book names no steelhead on — the steelhead rules apply, steelhead may not be present, and a rainbow over 50 cm is a rainbow
mechanisms.lake_no_steelhead: a lake of a steelhead region whose own row names no steelhead: no steelhead rule or stamp applies there (no `steelhead` on the part)
mechanisms.own_row_steelhead_lake: Khartoum or Lois Lake: the lake's own row names steelhead ('Rainbow trout/hatchery steelhead quota = 6 in the aggregate'), so it carries the whole provincial steelhead set and Region 2's wild release, as a steelhead stream does
mechanisms.lake_bound_by_a_steelhead_rows_other_lin: Tenas Lake: a steelhead row binds it by a line that is not about steelhead (the Atnarko/Bella Coola spring closure), but its own row prints no steelhead, so it is NOT steelhead water (user ruling 2026-10-06): no provincial steelhead rule or stamp; resident big rainbow are rainbow
mechanisms.steelhead_known_beyond_the_regions: a stream outside Regions 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 that a steelhead row binds (the Stellako in Zone 7A, whose row prints 'Steelhead Stamp not required'): it carries the provincial steelhead set (the twins) though its region's tables name no steelhead, and a rainbow over 50 cm is a steelhead
mechanisms.steelhead_known_by_the_list: a stream outside Regions 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 that only the curated known-steelhead list makes KNOWN (the Okanagan River, Region 8; `steelhead_source` ["curated list"]): steelhead are known to be there, but NO steelhead rule applies (`steelhead_rules: false`; the list binds no rule) — so a rainbow of any size is a rainbow trout (user ruling 2026-10-03), answered by the water's rainbow rules
mechanisms.same_row_dated_release: the Thompson below Kamloops Lake, its CNR stretch in May: the row's dated 'trout/char catch and release, May 1-31' displaces the same row's undated 'Trout/char daily quota = 2' (RU-3, `ladder.same_row_release`)
mechanisms.same_row_dated_closure: Alta Lake (Region 2) on Dec 15: the row's own 'No Fishing Dec 1-Mar 31' silences the same row's 'Trout/char daily quota combined = 2' on its dates (RU-3, a dated closure is such a release)
mechanisms.zone_release_any_water: a Zone 7B stream on May 15: the zone's dated grayling release (May 1-June 15, no water kind) silences the same table's 'Arctic grayling: 2' and 'only 1 over 45 cm' (RU-4, `ladder.zone_release_any_water`)
mechanisms.size_release_vs_size_clause: Lakelse Lake: its 'Rainbow trout over 50 cm catch and release' displaces Region 6's '1 over 50 cm'; Region 6's 'Trout/char: 5' still counts the smaller rainbow (RU-5, `ladder.size_release_vs_size_clause`)
mechanisms.closure_any_key: a Region 4 stream on May 1: the spring stream closure (`water: stream`) silences the region's 'Trout/char: 5' and '1 over 50 cm' as well as its own key's '2 from streams' (RU-7, `ladder.closure_any_key`)
mechanisms.two_regions_same_statement: Ahbau Lake (Region 5 / Zone 7A): both tables print 'Trout/char: 5' and '1 over 50 cm'; each is shown once, the lower entry id's (RU-8, `ladder.two_regions_same_statement`)
mechanisms.zone_size_clause_moot: Bonaparte Lake (Region 3, no row) on Nov 1: Region 3's lake trout release speaks and its 'none under 60 cm' is not shown — nothing is left for it to keep (`ladder.moot_size_clause`)
mechanisms.water_release_silences_size_clause: Griffin Lake (Region 3) on Nov 1: the lake's own 'Lake trout and bull trout (Dolly Varden) catch and release' silences Region 3's release AND its 'none under 60 cm' (`ladder.water_release`)
mechanisms.bridge_lake_same_statement: Bridge Lake (Region 5) on Jul 1: the lake's 'Lake trout daily quota = 1' is Region 5's '2 lake trout' with a smaller number, so the lake's 1 replaces the 2 (`ladder.quotas_sit_beside` case 1); 'Trout/char: 5' and '1 over 50 cm' still speak
mechanisms.bridge_lake_dated_zone_release: Bridge Lake (Region 5) on Nov 15: Region 5's dated 'Lake trout, Oct 1-Nov 30' (must release) speaks BESIDE the lake's undated 'Lake trout daily quota = 1' — none may be kept (`ladder.dated_zone_release` (B))
mechanisms.alta_lake_clause_size_release: Alta Lake (Region 2) on Jul 1: the lake's 'Trout/char daily quota combined = 2' replaces Region 2's 'Trout/char: 4'; its 'no trout over 40cm' is a CLAUSE of that quota (`within`), which RU-5 does not read, so Region 2's '1 over 50 cm' still speaks beside it although it keeps nothing

what_to_show.zone_only: {water} has no row of its own: show the region's rules for {fish} as the whole answer, labelled as the region's.
what_to_show.quota_beside: Show BOTH quotas for {fish} on {water} — the water's and the region's — each binds; never pick one.
what_to_show.larger_replaces: Show only {water}'s larger number for {fish}; the region's aggregate is lifted for that fish and must not appear.
what_to_show.same_statement: Show {water}'s number for {fish} in place of the region's identical statement; the region's line is gone.
what_to_show.water_release: Show {water}'s release for {fish}; the region's quota for it is silenced and must not appear.
what_to_show.naming_beats_group: The region's rule NAMING {fish} is the answer on {water}; the water's group rule does not speak for it.
what_to_show.water_names_fish: {water}'s own rule naming {fish} is the answer; the region's rule naming it is displaced.
what_to_show.within_clause_parent_level: {water}'s release speaks for {fish}; the region's clause naming {fish} is part of a group quota and does not beat it.
what_to_show.water_closure_silences_zone: On this date {water} is closed: show the closure; the region's quota for {fish} is silent.
what_to_show.derived_lift: {water}'s row names {fish}, so the region's closure of it is lifted here: show the row, not the closure.
what_to_show.printed_lift_reopens_closure: {water} prints an exemption: the region's closure of {fish} is lifted and must not appear.
what_to_show.closure_prints_its_exemptions: The region's closure lists its own exemptions and {water} is not one: show the closure for {fish}.
what_to_show.blanket_closure_exempt: {water} is exempt from the region's seasonal closure: show it open on this date.
what_to_show.equivalent_lift: {water}'s exemption reaches the same kind of closure in the other region it lies in: show that closure lifted too.
what_to_show.lift_for_one_fish: The lift on {water} is for another fish: the lifted rule still speaks for {fish} — show it.
what_to_show.partly_lifted: The rule still binds {fish} on {water} but is lifted for some anglers or fish: show it with a 'partly lifted' marker and the lift's condition.
what_to_show.counted_apart: {fish} is counted apart from the region's aggregate here: show its own number, not the aggregate.
what_to_show.two_regions_lake: {water} lies in two regions: show the stricter region's rule for {fish}; the other's is displaced.
what_to_show.home_region_differs: This piece of {water} takes the zone rules of the region it lies in, not its row's region: show those.
what_to_show.pointer: {water} is covered by the row it points at: show that row's rules and a link ('See …').
what_to_show.steelhead_water: On {water} a rainbow over 50 cm is a steelhead: rules about rainbow over 50 cm do not speak for {fish}.
what_to_show.dated_in_force: The water's dated rule for {fish} is in force on this date: show it.
what_to_show.dated_out_of_force: Outside its dates the water's rule is gone: show what the region says for {fish}.
what_to_show.semicolon_dated_clause: The date after the semicolon scopes only the clause before it; the first clause holds all year — show it.
what_to_show.part_day_decides: A rule in force only some hours or days decides then: show {water}'s answer for that moment (`at`), and say plainly that it differs at the other hours or days.
what_to_show.suspended_while: This is a LICENSING record (a licence, stamp or designation), dormant while its closure speaks: show the closure, and the licensing line as not required today. No regulation rule carries `suspended_while` — only licensing records do — so the rule list never changes because of it.
what_to_show.size_band: {water}'s quota for {fish} has a size window: show the sizes with the number.
what_to_show.origin: {water}'s rule is about hatchery or wild {fish} only: say which.
what_to_show.trout_word_same_statement: Show {water}'s trout number for {fish} in place of the region's 'Trout: 4'; a char there still answers to the region's char release. Show the trout note beside it.
what_to_show.dated_zone_release_stands: On this date show the region's release of {fish} BESIDE {water}'s own quota: the release binds, none may be kept.
what_to_show.water_dates_override: On this date {water}'s own quota for {fish} replaces the region's dated release (the water's dates overlap it, and the water's row wins on the overlap): show the water's quota and NOT the region's release — and, BESIDE the water's quota, the region's quotas that count {fish} with other fish (its 'Trout/char: 5' and clauses): an overridden release silences nothing. On the water's own release dates show its release.
what_to_show.one_side_beside: Show the closure on {water} with its side ('west half of the channel only'), prominently, BESIDE the rules the other half follows — never as the whole river closed.
what_to_show.while_or_targeting: The rule holds only while fishing a certain way or for a certain fish: show the condition with it.
what_to_show.gear_only: {water}'s own row says only how to fish: show the gear lines and the region's quotas for {fish}.
what_to_show.annual_clock: A quota on another clock than the day: show 'per licence year' (or the clock) with the number. Never add a 'record it on your licence' line of your own: if the quota has `recorded_by`, show that rule's text once, under it; if not, say nothing extra.
what_to_show.superior_authority: A federal or park rule: show it first; nothing below it opens what it closed.
what_to_show.standing: A rule that holds everywhere at undrawable places: show it as a note; it never decides the water.
what_to_show.angler_closure: {water} is closed to one kind of angler: show it conditionally ('if you are …').
what_to_show.tributary_walk: This water is a tributary: show the downstream row's rule as reaching it ('inherited from …').
what_to_show.watershed_part: A rule bound to part of a watershed: show it on this piece of {water}.
what_to_show.undrawn_part: Show this rule AT THE TOP of {water}, marked 'not yet mapped' with its part in words; it decides nothing.
what_to_show.licensing_classified: {water} is a classified water here: show the designation and the licence it requires, conditionally.
what_to_show.licensing_stamp: A stamp is required here for some anglers or fish: show it conditionally.
what_to_show.province_except: This part lies where a province-wide requirement stops (a national park): do not show that requirement here.
what_to_show.outside_bc: This part of {water} is outside B.C.: show 'outside B.C.', never 'no rules'.
what_to_show.clause_only_lift: {water}'s number lifts only a clause of the region's quota: show {water}'s number AND the region's aggregate for {fish} — it still counts toward it.
what_to_show.dated_lift: Outside the lifter's dates the region's rule speaks again: show it for {fish} on this date, and the water's own dated rule as not in force.
what_to_show.same_statement_smaller: {water} states the region's quota for {fish} with a smaller number: show {water}'s number only.
what_to_show.streams_only_zone_clause: On a stream the region's 'from streams' clause binds: show it with the aggregate for {fish}.
what_to_show.two_regions_closure: {water} lies in two regions and one closes {fish}: show the closure; the other region's open rule is displaced.
what_to_show.two_regions_release: {water} lies in two regions and one releases {fish}: show the release; the other region's quota is displaced.
what_to_show.keep_beside_release: Show the keeping clause and the release for {fish} side by side (e.g. hatchery kept, wild released) — both bind.
what_to_show.undrawn_closure: Show the closure at the top of {water} as a place NOT YET MAPPED; the rest of the water is open under the rules that speak.
what_to_show.size_clause_caution: Show {water}'s number for {fish} with the caution beside it: it overrides the region's 'only 1 over 50 cm', and whether '(any size)' means no size limit or only no minimum, the book does not say.
what_to_show.kootenay_rainbow_10: A rainbow on the main body answers to the lake's 10 (any size) alone; show the region's 5 for every other trout and char.
what_to_show.dean_beside: Show the Dean's 1 a day (none under 35 cm) beside Region 5's trout/char 5: both bind.
what_to_show.straddling_named_lake: {water} lies in two regions: show both regions' rules for {fish}, the stricter displacing the other where they say the same thing, and two identical statements (the same number) once.
what_to_show.steelhead_known: {water} is KNOWN steelhead water: show the steelhead rules that speak for {fish} (`expect`) plainly, with no caveat — the provincial set (the annual hatchery 10 with its record duty under it once, the wild release) and the region's steelhead lines, except where the water's own row displaces them (a row's release silences the 10) — and the Conservation Surcharge Stamp, conditionally (licensing). A rainbow over 50 cm here is a steelhead.
what_to_show.steelhead_possible: Steelhead rules apply on {water}, but the book names no steelhead on it: show the same steelhead rules for {fish} under the quiet line 'Steelhead rules apply here; steelhead may not be present in this water.' A rainbow over 50 cm here is a rainbow.
what_to_show.lake_no_steelhead: {water} carries no steelhead rule: show nothing about steelhead — no steelhead quota, release or stamp, no 'may not be present' line. A big rainbow here falls under the rainbow quota.
what_to_show.own_row_steelhead_lake: {water}'s own row names steelhead: show its own line and the provincial steelhead set for {fish} plainly — the annual hatchery 10 (its record duty under it, once), the wild release, the stamp (conditionally) — as on a known steelhead stream. A rainbow over 50 cm on the lake is still a rainbow (no `anadromous_rainbow`).
what_to_show.lake_bound_by_a_steelhead_rows_other_lin: {water} is NOT steelhead water: a steelhead row's other line binds it (show that line as it is), but the lake's own row prints no steelhead — no provincial steelhead rule or stamp. A big rainbow here is a rainbow under the lake's rainbow rules.
what_to_show.steelhead_known_beyond_the_regions: {water} is KNOWN steelhead water outside the steelhead regions: show the provincial steelhead set for {fish} plainly, with no caveat, beside its region's own rules. A rainbow over 50 cm here is a steelhead.
what_to_show.steelhead_known_by_the_list: {water} is on the curated known-steelhead list but no steelhead rule applies (`steelhead_rules: false`): show '{steelhead_no_rules}' and no steelhead rule. A rainbow of any size answers to the rules that speak for {fish} (`expect`).
what_to_show.same_row_dated_release: On this date show {water}'s own release of {fish} and NOT its undated daily quota: the row's dated release is its exception to its own number.
what_to_show.same_row_dated_closure: On this date {water} is closed by its own row: show the closure and NOT the row's quota.
what_to_show.zone_release_any_water: On this date the region's release of {fish} empties its own table's quota, its size-limited count and its size clause: show the release and NOT the quota.
what_to_show.size_release_vs_size_clause: Show {water}'s release of the large {fish} and the region's aggregate for the smaller ones; do NOT show the region's '1 over 50 cm' (nothing over 50 cm may be kept).
what_to_show.closure_any_key: On this date {water} is closed by the region's stream closure: show the closure and NONE of the region's quotas for {fish}.
what_to_show.two_regions_same_statement: {water} lies in two regions whose tables say the same thing for {fish}: show each identical line once.
what_to_show.zone_size_clause_moot: On this date show the region's release of {fish} and NOT its size clause: none may be kept, so the clause has nothing to say.
what_to_show.water_release_silences_size_clause: On this date show {water}'s own release of {fish} only: no zone quota, release or size clause.
what_to_show.bridge_lake_same_statement: Show {water}'s 1 lake trout a day, NOT the region's 2, beside the region's trout/char 5 and 1 over 50 cm.
what_to_show.bridge_lake_dated_zone_release: On this date show the region's lake trout release BESIDE {water}'s own 1 a day: the release binds, none may be kept.
what_to_show.alta_lake_clause_size_release: Show {water}'s 2 a day and its 'no trout over 40cm', and — as the reader answers today — the region's '1 over 50 cm' beside them (`expect`).
